prompt:
A horizontal strip of pixel art showing the vertical FRONT FACE of a raised wall/ledge, exactly as such faces look in a top-down JRPG map (we look straight at the face; it is the drop between an upper level and the floor). It fills the whole image edge to edge: the top 6% is the lit rim/lip of the upper surface, the face below gets gradually darker toward the bottom, and the bottom 8% is a dark contact band where it meets the floor. No floor, no sky, no objects in front. SEAMLESS horizontally (left edge continues into the right edge). The strip is about 256 x 128 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels). Material: the inner wall of a giant hollow tree: vertical ridged bark and living wood, knots, moss and a few thin roots.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
revised_prompt: Generate a single horizontal seamless tileable pixel-art texture, aspect ratio 2:1, designed as exactly 256 × 128 logical art pixels, enlarged with NEAREST-NEIGHBOR only so every logical pixel is a uniform sharp square (~7–8 display pixels). The image is ONLY the straight-on vertical FRONT FACE of a raised ledge in a top-down JRPG map: a continuous flat upright cross-section of the inner wall of a giant hollow tree, filling canvas edge to edge. At the very top, a narrow continuous warmly lit horizontal upper lip occupies roughly 6% of height; beneath it, the vertical bark and living-wood face darkens gently and evenly downward, finishing with a continuous dark contact band occupying bottom 8%. Do NOT show upper surface, floor, background, sky, horizon, props, characters, or foreground. Strong vertical rhythm of stylized bark ridges and narrow fissures; organic grain, a few small irregular knots, sparse patches of moss, and a few fine hanging roots integrated into the wood; earthy amber, ochre, caramel, walnut and dark brown, yellow-warm highlights and saturated reddish-purple darks, 4–6 distinct shades per material. Premium modern hi-bit JRPG pixel art, manually composed clean connected clusters of about 3–10 logical pixels, legible silhouettes, dimensional but controlled. Neutral soft uniform upper-left ambient daylight, no separate light source. CRITICAL: seamless horizontal wrap: every shape, contour, ridge, lip, and bottom band touching left image border continues exactly and perfectly at matching vertical position on right image border. No cast shadow, night grading, glow, vignetting, photographic textures, blur, anti-aliasing, gradients of fractional pixels, arbitrary noise, checkerboard dithering, or variable-size pixels.
